name: Pogo Jump
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart, knees nearly straight, core lightly braced, and arms bent at your sides.
Bounce vertically upward primarily through quick, stiff ankle extension rather than deep knee bending.
Pull your toes upward briefly in midair, then strike the floor rhythmically on the balls of your feet.
Rebound immediately off the ground with minimal contact time for consecutive elastic repetitions.
tips: Keep your heels off the floor and your legs relatively stiff like a spring rather than squatting into each hop.
Focus on quiet, snappy rebounds with tall posture and relaxed shoulders.
